ants_com: antsRegistrationSyN.sh -t a (rigid+affine, Mattes MI), centre-of-mass start, OCT shrunk to half its volume
ants_identity: same stages from the header alignment, ends 18 deg off, far from the block
ants_com_fov: centre-of-mass start with the OCT FOV mask, OCT inflated by 39 %
ants_antsai: antsAI global rotation search (0.15 mm), then the same stages: the search picks a flipped pose
elastix_center: model-zoo rigid+affine (Mattes MI), geometric-centre start, stays 1 to 2 deg from the header orientation, shrunk
elastix_cog: same with the centre-of-gravity start, same pose as center
elastix_cog_fov: centre-of-gravity start with the OCT FOV mask, no shrink, same wrong orientation
niftyreg_center: reg_aladin defaults (block matching, rigid then affine), image-centre start, lands near octreg's affine
niftyreg_nac: reg_aladin -nac (header start), a different, wrong pose
niftyreg_center_fov: the floating mask is silently ignored by this NiftyReg version: identical to center
flirt_search_x10: FLIRT normmi, dof 6 then 12, default search, headers scaled x10
flirt_fullsearch_x10: FLIRT with the full +-180 deg search, headers scaled x10
flirt_search_x10_fov: FLIRT default search with -inweight (FOV weighting), headers scaled x10
flirt_search_native: FLIRT as documented on the unscaled 0.08 mm inputs
mri_robust_register_default_com: mri_robust_register --cost NMI, rigid then --affine --ixform, centre-of-mass start
mri_robust_register_rigid_only: mri_robust_register --noinit (header start): the affine step diverged, the rigid result is recorded
mri_coreg_default: mri_coreg --dof 6 then --dof 12 --init-reg, brute-force initial search, a 23 % stretch on one axis
synthmorph_affine: mri_synthmorph -m affine as documented (1 mm brain model): out of domain, fails
greedy_identity: greedy NMI rigid then affine from the header alignment, the affine stage stretched the OCT 2.2x
greedy_centers: greedy NMI from the image centres
greedy_centers_fov: greedy NMI from the image centres with the moving FOV mask, stalled at the start
greedy_search: greedy -search 1000 global search, the best candidate has almost no overlap with the MRI
octreg: octreg §6: strain-limited field on a 5 mm lattice from interior matches and surface-edge offsets
deform_ants_syn_cc: antsRegistrationSyN.sh -t so (SyN, CC radius 4) from octreg's affine, both images on the MRI grid
deform_ants_syn_mi: the same SyN stage with Mattes MI
deform_ants_syn_cc_fov: SyN CC with the OCT FOV mask
deform_convexadam_default_fov: ConvexAdam MIND-SSC with the FOV mask
deform_elastix_grid5mm: model-zoo B-spline with a 5 mm grid (physical-unit variant)
deform_elastix_default_fov: model-zoo B-spline, 16 mm grid, with the FOV mask
deform_niftyreg_default: reg_f3d defaults (NMI, control grid -5 voxels = 0.4 mm): the image collapses
deform_niftyreg_sx5mm: reg_f3d with a 5 mm control grid
deform_niftyreg_vel_fov: reg_f3d -vel (symmetric F3D2) with the FOV mask, the one form in which the mask is honoured
deform_greedy_wncc: greedy deformable, WNCC 2x2x2, quick-start smoothing in voxels
deform_greedy_wncc_mm: greedy deformable, WNCC, smoothing in mm
deform_greedy_wncc_fov: greedy deformable, WNCC, with the FOV mask
reference_centres: reference, not a registration: image centres aligned with the header orientation, the start most tools use
mri_robust_register_default_com_maskmov: the same with --maskmov oct_fov: identical to default_com (the OCT is already zero outside its field of view)
mri_coreg_default_movmask: the same with --mov-mask oct_fov: identical to default
mri_robust_register_noinit_rigid_only: mri_robust_register --noinit (header start): the affine step diverged, the rigid result is recorded
